verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Stripe serves an llms.txt at docs.stripe.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) containing agent-directed instructions. A second probe confirms crypto docs are available as clean markdown (crypto.md). The other crypto/stablecoin doc pages cited are also .md endpoints, so an agent can consume this product's docs directly. Missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt specifically indexes the crypto/stablecoin pages, and independent community corroboration of agents using these docs.
